name: The Shoreline
subtitle: Family Mastermind
tagline: A family mastermind, rooted and growing together

verse.short: Even there your hand will guide me.
verse.full: Even there your hand will guide me, your right hand will hold me fast.

dedication: In loving memory of Marie & Shane
rules: What's said in the room stays in the room. Ask before sharing someone's story.
Show up. If you can't make it, tell Mark before the day of.
Check in before the meeting starts so we can read wins and challenges ahead of time.
Hot seat prep is in 24 hours before the meeting.
Phones face down during the meeting, except to take notes.
Advice is a gift. Say thank you, then decide for yourself.
Everyone leaves with one commitment, and we follow up on it.
